chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn Maysarah narrated that he asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Can a man perform salat while sitting cross-legged and with his legs outstretched?
So he said: “There is no harm in that.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat while sitting cross-legged or with the legs outstretched?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat performed while sitting. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no harm in praying while seated cross-legged or with the legs outstretched, indicating permissibility in such sitting postures.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1050 - Muawiya ibn Maysara narrated from  Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"Can a person pray while sitting in the position of tawarruk (cross-legged) or with his legs spread out?"
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that."
